from pathlib import Path
from pypdf import PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import ContentStream
from PIL import Image
import hashlib
import json
import numpy as np
import sys

base = Path(sys.argv[1])
evidence = base / 'workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence'
out = evidence / 'geometry-001'
analysis = json.loads((out / 'analysis.json').read_text())
for item in analysis['inputs']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((base / item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
source = PdfReader(evidence / 'stock-editor-round-trip-001/source.pdf')
export = PdfReader(evidence / 'implementation-0014/result.pdf')
cropped = PdfReader(out / 'source-window-candidate.pdf')
assert len(source.pages) == len(export.pages) == len(cropped.pages) == 1
for doc in (source, export, cropped):
    page = doc.pages[0]
    assert page.get('/Rotate', 0) == 0 and page.get('/UserUnit', 1) == 1
samples = lambda doc: doc.pages[0]['/Resources']['/XObject']['/Source'].get_object().get_data()
assert samples(source) == samples(export) == samples(cropped)
for doc in (source, export, cropped):
    ops = ContentStream(doc.pages[0].get_contents(), doc).operations
    assert ops[:4] == [([], b'q'), ([800, 0, 0, 1000, 0, 0], b'cm'), (['/Source'], b'Do'), ([], b'Q')]
assert list(cropped.pages[0].mediabox) == list(cropped.pages[0].cropbox) == [0, 0, 800, 1000]
source_pixels = np.asarray(Image.open(out / 'source.png').convert('RGB'))
candidate = np.asarray(Image.open(out / 'source-window-candidate.png').convert('RGB'))
expanded = np.asarray(Image.open(out / 'integer-expanded-analysis.png').convert('RGB'))
assert source_pixels.shape == candidate.shape == (1000, 800, 3)
for x, y in ((60, 60), (740, 60), (60, 940), (740, 940)):
    region = (slice(y - 20, y + 20), slice(x - 20, x + 20))
    assert np.array_equal(source_pixels[region], candidate[region])
def red_mask(pixels, delta):
    p = pixels.astype(np.int16)
    return (p[:, :, 0] > 100) & (p[:, :, 0] - p[:, :, 1] > delta) & (p[:, :, 0] - p[:, :, 2] > delta)
counts = []
for delta in (10, 20, 40, 60):
    mask = red_mask(expanded, delta)
    assert np.array_equal(mask[:1000, 32:832], red_mask(candidate, delta))
    inside = int(mask[:1000, 32:832].sum())
    counts.append({'delta': delta, 'inside': inside, 'outside': int(mask.sum()) - inside})
print(json.dumps({'status': 'PASS', 'source_mapping': 'identity', 'candidate_dimensions': [800, 1000], 'corner_regions_identical': 4, 'red_mask_counts': counts, 'delivery_status': 'not delivered; clipping confirmation policy unimplemented'}))
